title: The Worldbreaker
summary: A shadow falls over Brightport. VASTOR has arrived. He is very tall, very armored, and very rude.

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Big readings downtown! Something is crushing buildings. I don't like it. Get there!

dialogue.speaker: VASTOR
dialogue.text: Hm. A city. How charming. How BREAKABLE.

dialogue.speaker: VASTOR
dialogue.text: You tiny sparks! I am VASTOR, the Worldbreaker! Try to dent me!

dialogue.speaker: VASTOR
dialogue.text: Impressive. You hurt me! ...I'll be back, with all of the worlds behind me!

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: He got away, and half the skyline came with him. He's heading for the Sugarworks. Upgrade, then follow!
